instruction: Choose a suitable engineering drawing/CAD application available in the current Ubuntu environment. The task is to edit a DXF drawing, so select software that can reliably open, modify, and export DXF files. Open or import /home/user/Desktop/gui07_hatch_section_seed.dxf. On layer HATCH, add section hatch fill inside the outer rectangular region while keeping the two circular holes empty and not covered by hatch. Use an ANSI31-style hatch pattern or an equivalent 45 degree diagonal-line hatch, with scale 1 and angle 45 degrees. Save as /home/user/Desktop/gui07_hatch_section_completed.dxf. Complete the work through an interactive graphical workflow and save/export the required DXF file to the exact Desktop path stated above. Do not generate the drawing with external scripts, command-line CAD generation, or by directly writing DXF entities programmatically.
